name: KanbanGridView.vue
description:
Here's a 5-line summary:

1. The task was to add a **"plus" icon button** to each Kanban column group header when `groupBy === 'column'` in `KanbanGridView.vue`.
2. The button opens a **DaisyUI dropdown menu** listing the 4 task types (Chat, Document, Discussion, PR Review) with their respective `ChatIcon` components.
3. Clicking a type calls `emitNewTaskForColumn(groupKey, mode)`, which **resolves the column object** by title from the `columns` prop before emitting the `new-task` event.
4. The emitted payload follows the existing `{ column, mode }` shape expected by the **parent `Kanban.vue`** component.
5. The existing **edit pen button** (`fa-pen`) was preserved alongside the new plus button in the column header actions area.

Looking at the request, I need to reorganize the `KanbanGridView.vue` so that: 1. "New Task" button is in the filter bar header 2. "Group by" and "Sort" are inside the collapsible filter body 3. This saves space for the cards ```vue src/components/kanban/KanbanGridView.vue ``` ### Key changes - **Removed** the separate toolbar row (the one with "New Task" + "Group by") — that whole `
` block is gone - **"New Task" button** is now a `btn-xs` dropdown placed inside the filter header row, next to the task count badge — click propagation is stopped so it doesn't toggle the filter panel - **"Group by"** and **"Sort"** selects moved inside the collapsible filter body, separated by a subtle divider line (`border-t`) at the bottom of the filter options, keeping them logically grouped but visually distinct from the data filters - The result is one single compact bar instead of two rows, giving more vertical space to the card grid
Extract the "collapsible" functionality to a new component components/Collapsible.vue so we can reuse in other components

Looking at the `KanbanGridView.vue`, I can see the collapsible filter bar pattern. I'll extract this into a reusable `Collapsible.vue` component using slots, then update `KanbanGridView.vue` to use it. ```vue src/components/Collapsible.vue ``` Now update `KanbanGridView.vue` to use the new `Collapsible` component: ```vue src/components/kanban/KanbanGridView.vue ``` ### Summary of changes **New `src/components/Collapsible.vue`:** - Accepts `defaultOpen` (uncontrolled) and `modelValue` (controlled via `v-model`) props - Exposes four slots: `#icon`, `#title`, `#summary` (always visible in header row), `#actions` (buttons in header row), and the default slot for the collapsible body - Uses a computed `isOpen` getter/setter to support both controlled and uncontrolled usage - Chevron rotates based on open state **Updated `KanbanGridView.vue`:** - Removed the manual collapsible `filtersOpen` data property and its toggle logic - Wraps the entire filter bar in `` using the named slots for icon, title, active chip summary, header action buttons, and body content - All filter logic, computed properties and methods remain unchanged
